sanskrit_verse:
पूर्वं कृता क्रिया या तु पालनीया तथैव सा ।
अन्यथा क्रियते यत्र क्रियाभेदस् तदा भवेत् ॥
transliteration: pūrvaṃ kṛtā kriyā yā tu pālanīyā tathaiva sā | anyathā kriyate yatra kriyābhedas tadā bhavet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Any action initiated must be sustained in its original form; when it is altered, it becomes a deviation requiring immediate restoration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the integrity of initiation
Causation is maintained through continuity of intent
Capacity-based responsibility requires preservation of original action-form
Restoration logic demands correction at point of divergence
Consciousness alignment occurs through adherence to pristine execution
executable_legal_axioms: IF an initiated action deviates from its original form THEN trigger restorative realignment protocol
IF consciousness-intent diverges from manifest form THEN assign completion responsibility to initiating agent
IF action-sequence shows structural variance THEN halt downstream processing until integrity is restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that any legislative or executive act must remain consistent with its originating constitutional intent. Deviation constitutes actionable misalignment requiring judicial restoration rather than punitive invalidation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality locates responsibility at the point of divergence. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that distortion propagates error unless corrected. Proportional responsibility rests solely on restoring the original causal stream without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Consciousness Re-alignment Process (CRP) for the acting entity
Deploy Completion Tracking Mechanism to restore original sequence
Assign Integrity Restoration Officer to oversee re-synchronization
Activate Dharma Field Stabilization Protocol to prevent further divergence
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Action conforms to consciousness; deviation dissolves upon restoration. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
